name: Offline Earnings
description: Earn cash while you're offline. Each level sets how much of your offline rate you get.

sections.heading: What you need to know
list: You only get paid if you were offline for more than 15 minutes. Leave for 15 minutes or less and you get nothing.
Once you're past 15 minutes, the whole time counts (the first 15 minutes aren't taken off), up to a maximum of 7 days. Anything past 7 days is wasted.
You're paid all at once the next time you join, in the "You just earned … while you were offline" popup.
Each mastery level is your total multiplier, not an amount added on top of the last level: max level is 0.6x (60%).

sections.heading: How the payout is worked out
formula: payout = offline rate × seconds offline × mastery multiplier
offline rate = (sum of value ÷ timeAlive for your last 50 sold ores) ÷ 50
timeAlive = seconds from the ore dropping to being sold (never less than 1)
list: The game remembers your last 50 sold ores, and for each one how much it sold for and how long it was alive.

Your offline rate is NOT your cash per minute. Each ore counts as its value spread over its own trip, so it's like having only one ore on your belt at a time. More droppers or a faster drop rate don't raise it.
It always divides by 50. If fewer than 50 ores are remembered, the empty slots count as 0 — 25 ores gives you half the rate.
Ores are forgotten once they're about 10 minutes old (counting only time you're in the game), so only ores sold in your last ~10 minutes before leaving count.

sections.heading: Tips
list: Keep your base selling right up until you leave, at about 5 or more ores a minute for 10 minutes, so all 50 slots are filled. If your base was stopped for 10 minutes before leaving, you get nothing.
Fast, valuable ore pays the most: what counts is each ore's value ÷ its trip time. The same ore on a 30-second route pays 1.5x what it pays on a 45-second route.
Only let your best ore reach the furnace before you leave. Every sold ore takes one of the 50 slots, so cheap ore from a secondary dropper drags the average down.
A dropper feeding straight into a furnace counts as 1 second, even if the ore is sold faster than that.

sections.heading: Tested example
list: 2 Butterfly Droppers (5M ore) into a Basic Furnace (1x), no upgraders, about 0.5 seconds from drop to sale (counts as 1 second), run for 10 minutes before leaving, max mastery (0.6x).
Offline rate: 5M ÷ 1 second = 5M per second. Offline for 32:50 (1,970 seconds).
Predicted: 5M × 1,970 × 0.6 = 5.91B. The game paid 5.72B — within about 3%.
